items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Yeah I just watched him play it with Cedar Walton on a video the other day.

ctx.x: It would have had a different tone. But “Little B’s Poem”; Bobby Hutcherson, he had played that. And I’ll tell you Bobby Hutcherson ended up having to play my arrangement of “Little B’s Poem.” As it worked out you know that intro [scats] because he had played many shows and people would ask him, “Hey, did you write ‘Little B’s Poem?’” And he said, “Yeah I wrote it.” He says, “Play that.” So he started going [scats]. He said, “No that ain’t how it goes” [scats] so they started playing. They went and got Joey…
I see. Yeah I just watched him play it with Cedar Walton on a video the other day.

Yeah. And so you know I put a lot of thought in it you know, and to tell people you spent a great deal of your time thinking. They can’t get to that you know. You know they can’t get to that. He’s supposed to be spending a great deal of your time putting stress on your back and lifting weights you know.
